{{Top|leg}}
'''Midnite Forsberg''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[Omicron Hunter-21X]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His route including making regular runs through [[Isryn's Veil]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He eventually appeared on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scanners who were stationed on Dantooine, prompting them to make an attempt to arrest him.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|290|Forsberg, Midnite}}</ref>
